entry.subject: First integrated Calcifer ignition simulation with POMS + PEMFC + AFPM + dual battery + maintenance architecture
entry.trigger: Run the whole current JANUS Engine architecture as far as existing measured/literature anchors allow and save the result.
entry.scope_boundary: Numerical integrated launch only; no physical JANUS hardware was started.
result: The integrated model was run for 6 h with 0.5 h prime, 4 h linear PEMFC ramp and 1.5 h hold. Screening auxiliaries were frozen at 12/10/8 W for those stages.

At the nominal 0.130 mg/m2/s POMS target, the RUN005 empirical electrical-conversion branch reaches +2.3403 W steady net at 8 W auxiliaries but does not repay startup/bidirectional-converter losses inside 6 h; modeled total recovery occurs near 16.49 h if steady conditions persist.

At the same flux with the paper 55% design-conversion branch, total dual-pack stored energy returns to its initial level around 4.09 h and ends the 6 h screen about +33.03 Wh after 95% charge/discharge DC/DC efficiencies.

Across the matrix, the 55% design branch passes the 6 h battery-neutral screen from 0.100 mg/m2/s upward. The empirical branch requires higher flux and longer hold; 0.160 and 0.1707 mg/m2/s repay startup at about 9.34 h and 8.28 h respectively under this screening schedule.
No AFPM regenerative watts were credited because an independent hydraulic/mechanical input has not yet been measured. This prevents same-shaft double counting.
Two batteries improved support/recovery separation and regenerative headroom but did not change the governing energy balance.

The selected nominal 0.130 mg/m2/s six-hour flux trajectory corresponds to about 34.74 g O2 throughput and about 4.38 g theoretical stoichiometric H2 minimum; hydrogen remains the explicit external chemical-energy source.
entry.decision: Proceed to RUN007 only by replacing assumed 12/10/8 W parasitics and conversion values with measured subsystem data. The current result is a conditional model pass, not hardware self-drive proof.
next_measurements: water pump watts and DeltaP at the actual POMS cassette flow
AFPM motor/generator efficiency and zero-current crossover
purge gas mass/pressure work every 30 min
POMS J_O2 through startup and long hold
PEMFC gross/net efficiency at the actual oxygen delivery rate
